sections.title: From Concrete to Abstract (0:00-1:00)
lecture_lines: Think of vectors as familiar 2D arrows.
Can these rules apply to other objects?
We define a Vector Space with eight axioms.
These rules transcend the objects' physical form.
Objects simply need to satisfy these eight properties.
animations: Show a set of physical objects like apples using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/apple.svg]. Color: #FF6347 (Tomato). Label: 'Concrete'.
Transform the apples into dots on a coordinate grid. Color: #4682B4 (SteelBlue). Label: 'Representation'.

Show the transition from coordinate dots to generic vectors using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/apple.svg] as the base for abstraction. Color: #32CD32 (LimeGreen). Label: 'Abstract'.

sections.title: The Two 'Magical' Operations (1:00-2:15)
lecture_lines: Vector spaces require two fundamental operations.
First, we must be able to add vectors.
Second, we must allow scalar multiplication.
animations: Draw two arrows representing vector space. Color: #FFFFFF (White). Label: 'Operations'. [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg]
Animate two arrows adding head-to-tail to form a new vector. Color: #FFD700 (Gold). Label: 'Vector Addition'.
Scale one arrow to be double its length. Color: #00CED1 (DarkTurquoise). Label: 'Scalar Multiplication'. [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg]

sections.title: Defining the 'Rules of the Game' (2:15-3:30)
lecture_lines: These eight axioms form the structural blueprint.
They ensure consistent behavior for all vectors.
Commutativity and associativity are essential requirements.
animations: Display a list of 8 items numbered 1 to 8 using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/blueprint.svg] as a background template. Color: #E0FFFF (LightCyan). Label: 'Axioms'.
Highlight all items to show consistency. Color: #FF4500 (OrangeRed). Label: 'Structure'.
Flash the commutative property 'a+b=b+a'. Color: #FFD700 (Gold). Label: 'Commutativity'.

sections.title: Applications: The Zoo of Vectors (3:30-4:30)
lecture_lines: Vector spaces include polynomials and functions.
This zoo shows the versatility of vectors.
Engineers use these to analyze complex signals.
animations: Show a set of polynomials f(x) = ax^2 + bx + c. Color: #9370DB (MediumPurple). Label: 'Polynomials'. [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/microphone.svg]
Transition from polynomial graph to signal wave. Color: #00FF7F (SpringGreen). Label: 'Signals'.
Group both under a large label 'Vector Zoo'. Color: #FF6347 (Tomato). Label: 'Versatility'. [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/oscilloscope.svg]

sections.title: Conclusion: The Power of Generalization (4:30-5:00)
lecture_lines: Abstract vector spaces unify diverse fields.
They connect physics, AI, and signal processing.
animations: Show icons of Physics [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/atom.svg], AI [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/robot.svg], and Signals [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/antenna.svg] converging. Color: #FFFFFF (White). Label: 'Fields'.
Connect them with thin lines to a central core 'Vector Space'. Color: #FFFF00 (Yellow). Label: 'Unification'.
Zoom out to show the central core shining brightly using the microscope [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/microscope.svg] view. Color: #FFD700 (Gold). Label: 'Abstract Power'.
